استنتجتا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْتَجَتَا (istantajatā) /is.tan.ta.d͡ʒa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
# اُسْتُنْتِجَتَا (ustuntijatā) /us.tun.ti.d͡ʒa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
